info.title: Class of '09
info.author: catsandgats
info.description: homebrew port of Class of '09 runtime
info.details:
A native Nintendo Switch homebrew port of the Class of '09 runtime.

Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with the game's developers or publishers, Nintendo, or Sony.

*Release does NOT include any retail game assets - users must supply game folder

Copy game folder from retail copy of Class of '09 to sdmc:/switch/class09/assets/ on the switch

Final folder layout should appear as sdmc:/switch/class09/assets/game/

AI use: Co-written with AI.
